info.name: Elanster CMS — full backend test
info.description: Tests every part of the Elanster CMS backend. Run the whole collection (Run → Run Elanster CMS). Set the variables first: baseUrl, email, password, siteSlug. It creates a test article, category and image, then deletes them. The Pages folder changes one text on the live website for a few seconds and then puts it back.
